007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009/**
010 * Result returned by a Select AI Agent team run.
011 *
012 * <p>The database may return a final answer, status information, or a
013 * database-defined JSON document. This model preserves the returned value
014 * without imposing a database-version-specific schema.</p>
015 *
016 * <p>This class inherits {@link Object#toString()} so ordinary object logging
017 * does not include response content. Use {@link #getRawValue()} explicitly
018 * when the response is needed, and review it before logging.</p>
019 *
020 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/RunTeamSample.html">
021 *      RunTeamSample source</a>
022 * @since 1.1.0
023 */
024public final class TeamRunResult {
025    /** Exact value returned by the database team run. */
026    private final String rawValue;
027
028    /**
029     * Creates a team-run result.
030     *
031     * @param rawValue value returned by the database, possibly {@code null}
032     */
033    public TeamRunResult(String rawValue) {
034        this.rawValue = rawValue;
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * Creates a result from a database value.
039     *
040     * @param rawValue value returned by the database
041     * @return result, or {@code null} when the database returned no value
042     */
043    public static TeamRunResult fromRawValue(String rawValue) {
044        return rawValue == null ? null : new TeamRunResult(rawValue);
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * Returns the exact value returned by the database.
049     *
050     * @return final answer, status text, or JSON returned by the database
051     */
052    public String getRawValue() {
053        return rawValue;
054    }
055}
